Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1840); Daniel, an Israelite:--Daniel.
BiblicalUsage: Daniel is named once in the Gospels, and it is Jesus who names him: when you shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, then let them which be in Judaea flee. The prophet's name carries the authority of the prophecy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Lord's use of Daniel's name settles the prophet's standing: Jesus treats his words as Scripture, and so do I.
